lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-luminance circular clusters is distributed in horizontal rows posterior to the branchial region, with larger blobs positioned centrally on the flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of subtly elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of spots, forming a characteristic lattice pattern where the blobs serve as primary grid nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal ridge is visible in the upper third of the visible flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical luminance gradient with a lighter dorsal edge and a shadowed ventral edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A small, bright white linear mark is visible posterior to the upper section of the fifth gill slit. Minor irregular pale markings are present on the tissue between the fourth and fifth gill slits.
other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin exhibits a high-density population of significantly smaller high-luminance spots, particularly concentrated along the anterior leading edge.
